content_fields.title: Authenticate and log all access to registries containing sensitive or proprietary images
content_fields.description: Authenticate and log every access to registries holding this project's images.
content_fields.guidance: Registry access should require an identity, log every pull and push with the identity and image digest, and ship those records to central log storage for review.
content_fields.found: Images are pulled anonymously from a public registry; no private registry or access logging exists.
content_fields.missing: A private registry with authentication and an audit log destination.
content_fields.conclusion: Registry authentication and logging are properties of the registry service, configured outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should require authentication and enable access logging on the registry.
